Rhukk is full body, centered, his proportions exactly those of the supplied image in every frame. He has exactly four clawed arms, two legs and one great curved horn. He stays in the exact same front three-quarter view as the image the whole clip: his horn always points to image-right, his red eyes always face the viewer, his shell stays behind him. In the first second his knees bend sharply, his hips sink and his head lowers into a compact coil. In the next second he performs ONE deep puncturing headbutt: his rear leg drives his hips, chest and head forward together as his front foot takes one short step toward image-right. His original horn travels forward with his head in a fast, decisive stabbing thrust. He immediately pulls his head and chest back out of the thrust, rather than staying lowered. His four arms bend back for balance and his knees absorb the drive. Over the next two seconds his whole body recovers and his front foot returns to its opening position. For the remaining two seconds he breathes naturally in his opening stance. The puncture happens only once: fast in, then out. All in one fluid motion with no pause. Matte background casts no light on him. He settles into exactly his opening stance on the final frame.
